Call Wrap up Summary

## **PROBLEM STATEMENT:**

Call center agent has to undertake many actions manually to log a call that adds to admin burden:

### 

| Salesforce Feature | Activity | Activity Goal | Example Scenario |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Global Search for Member Identification** | Typing DOB or MRN | Before the agent even speaks, Salesforce performs an automated task via CTI (Computer Telephony Integration). | Finding a patient who is calling from a new number. |
| **Case Object** | Creating a Record | A "Case" is created for that specific phone call/issue. An agent rarely takes a call without creating or updating a Case | Documenting a formal complaint about a rude doctor. |
| **Activity/Task** | "Assign To" | Interaction Logging & Note Taking **Free-Text Notes:** In the "Description" or "Internal Comments" field of the Case, the agent types a narrative **Log a Call Activity:** Even if no Case is created (for simple quick calls), the agent uses the **Activity Timeline** on the right side of the screen. Creating "Tasks" for Future Action: If the issue isn't solved immediately, the agent creates a **Task** (a To-Do list item). | Sending a request to the Billing Dept to audit an account. |
| **Knowledge** | Search & Attach | Salesforce has a "Knowledge Base" widget (usually on the right sidebar) which CSR leverages to search details  | Finding the "Visitor Policy during Flu Season" to read to a caller. |

## **OBJECTIVE:**

Automate the case creation and call wrap up JBTDs for the voice and assisted AI use cases.  
The solution must holistically consider the entire routing process, including situations where an autonomous voice agent handles an issue or transfers it to a human agent. The goal is for the voice agent to autonomously create a case for "happy path" or simpler issues, while more complex use cases are transferred to a human agent. The end result should be the same whether handled by a human or voice agent, involving the creation of a case or activity/task.

* System should suggest the next best action (e.g., "create a case") to the human agent, rather than the agent explicitly deciding

See details on Zing Health launching a similar Voice Agent: Link

## **REQUIREMENTS:**

Ship a voice agent template (Service Assistant Agent with Voice modality) that allows payer customers divert low risk queries (such as status, eligibility, etc.) to a voice agent that allows e2e call orchestration:

- Identifies and verifies caller  
- Creates engagement records  
- Orchestrates between topics based on intent / sentiments  
- Escalates / does live agent handoff as needed  
- Search an existing case or create a new case as needed  
- Call wrap up & summary  
- Send emails, optionally

Refer to complete flow here & refer to below table for detailed requirements:  
Ship **a voice agent template** that automates these tasks for a Call Center Representative.  
Per [Platform Advisor]There is nothing called a voice agent, it will be based on the Agent Employee Assistant template and should be tested for phone, SMS, and web chat (which are functionally the same, and that there is no voice-specific functionality.)

* \[P0\] Flow to identify & verifies the caller when ANI fails  
  * Create a new action to identify user with full name & DOB  
  * Conduct a technical spike to evaluate and leverage existing [Identity Verification flows](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ind.admin_contact_center_identity_verification_and_engagement_details.htm&type=5)  
* \[P2-TBD\] Topic to create engagement records  
  * Voice object records are automatically created and have the same purpose. Creation of engagement interaction records is not a std. our customers follow  
  * engagement interaction | engagement attendee | engagement topic  
* Flow & prompt for intent extraction to connect to the right other topics based on caller’s intent  
  * Per [Platform Engineer]Intent extraction and sentiment analysis are not provided out of the box and must be built using a record-triggered flow with an embedded prompt template to instruct the LLM on how to extract and stamp the desired data onto the voice call record  
  * Per [Voice Agent SME]who worked on releasing a member benefits inquiry voice agent, this is pretty straightforward and can be done with writing the right instructions.   
* Sentiment analysis:   
  * Per [Platform Advisor]Sentiment is extracted from the text but is not OOTB feature; it requires post-processing via a flow and an LLM prompt template to stamp it on the voice call record  
  * Per [Voice Agent SME]who worked on releasing a member benefits inquiry voice agent, this is pretty straightforward and can be done with writing the right instructions.   
* Topic for Escalates to human agent as needed   
  * use existing OOTB Escalation Action  
  * default or explicit escalation \- when user says “connect with me a human agent”  
  * dynamic & contextual escalation \- based on sentiment analysis (member seems frustrated or angry or needs urgent assistance) or VA unable to find corresponding topic   
  * Conversation catch-up Std feature to provide the human agent with a summary of everything that has happened  
* searches / creates a case for an incoming call \- custom changes on SCV OOTB capability \[[1](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.rn_voice_omni_flow_templates.htm&release=240&type=5),[2](https://trailhead.salesforce.com/trailblazer-community/feed/0D54S00000PeR5kSAF),[3](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.rn_voice_omni_flow_templates.htm&release=240&type=5)\]  
  * search an existing case  
  * Else, create a new case for all inquiries  
  * If user is asking multiple unrelated inquiries, create a case for each unrelated inquiry  
  * pref-fill Case record details from the call transcription  
  * create task if applicable, attached to case  
  * Update case comments, description, status, etc.  
  * Auto-close case if no follow up work needed  
* send emails as applicable \- [send email action](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.flow_ref_elements_actions_sendemail.htm&type=5) | [send email from a flow](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=platform.flow_build_actions_email.htm&type=5)  
* post call summary attached to voice call recording

Initial CC setup, routing logic , escalation queue & flows will be out of scope as this is already available by platform. Refer to the video for details.

## **SETUP** {#setup}

The Setup should be on existing PCC page with a separate section for Summaries

**Only Voice**

## **Configure Voice-Enabled Service Agent for Case wrap up & Summary** 

To create a voice-enabled agent, create a new agent, create a telephony connection, and configure voice mode settings.

### 

### **Assign User Permissions**

Assign the Health Cloud Foundation, Contact Center, Agentforce for Health, etc. permission set to contact center representatives. Create an Einstein type User for running service agent  
CTA: Go to Users

#### **Set Up Agentforce Voice** 

Prerequisites: Setup Salesforce Voice   
Get up and running with Agentforce Voice. Before you start, review the Voice prerequisites, limitations, and planning resources.  
[Show Me How in Help](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=service.voice_setup.htm&type=5)  
CTA: Enable Service Cloud Voice 

#### **Create a Voice-Enabled Service Agent**

Prerequisites: Setup Claims Assistant, Prior Auth Assistant, Provider Network Search, Answer with Knowledge subagents ([Link](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ind.hc_admin_pcc_agentforce.htm&type=5))  
To create a voice-enabled agent, create a new agent by selecting \<new\_agent\_template\> in Agent builder, add a voice-enabled connection, such as Telephony and configure voice mode settings. Ensure Identity Verification, Claims Assistant, Prior Auth Assistant, Answer with Knowledge subagents are already added to the agent.  
[Show Me How in Help](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ai.service_agent_voice.htm&type=5)  
CTA: Enable Agentforce Voice

## **Configure Call Routing and Call Escalation for the Agent**

Configure an Omni-Channel flow to transfer inbound calls to the voice-enabled agent. Create an escalation Omni-Channel flow to disconnect the agent and, if supported by your telephony or CCaaS system, transfer the call to a rep. Add the activated escalation flow to the agent.  
[Show Me How in Help](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ai.agent_call_routing_escalation.htm&type=5)  
CTA: Go to Flows

### **Review Flows**

Review the flows that create cases post voice call and messaging chat. For example, update the \<Voice\_flow\>  with phone no. associated with the Agentforce agent as well as chat channel in the \<messaging\_flow\>. Ensure flows are active.  
Show Me How in Help  
CTA: Go to Flows

### **Set up Case Auto-Response Rules to send email for new cases created**

To enable callers track the new case created, setup Case Auto-Response Rules and select appropriate email template within this setup  
[Show Me How in Help](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=service.creating_auto-response_rules.htm&type=5)  
CTA: Go to Case Auto-Response Rules

What service cloud will provide:

* Telephony system offering inbound/outbound calling via CCaaS (e.g., Amazon Connect)  
* Real-Time Transcription & AI: Calls are transcribed instantly, enabling Einstein to offer recommended articles and next-best-action prompts. Transcript is stored on the **Voice Call** record  
* Call recording on Voice Call object  
* Call metadata (ANI, queue, agent, timestamps)  
* Screen pop for agents  
* Call controls in Salesforce  
* Intelligent Routing: Uses IVR (Interactive Voice Response) to identify customer intent and route calls to the best-suited agent.
